title: Inspecting the Python Runtime and Notebook Environment
description: Import sys, platform, and subprocess, define a shell helper _sh(cmd), and print the Python version, OS platform, and whether google.colab is loaded.

steps.description: Import `sys`, `platform`, and `subprocess` and define `_sh(cmd)` to run a shell command with `subprocess.check_output` inside a `try/except` block.
Print `sys.version`, `platform.platform()`, and `"google.colab" in sys.modules` to report the runtime environment.
Look at line 11 (`"google.colab" in sys.modules`): checking `sys.modules` tests whether the `google.colab` package has been imported in the current Python session, returning a boolean.

steps.question: Does `_sh(cmd)` on lines 2-7 execute during this cell, and what boolean does `"google.colab" in sys.modules` print when running outside Google Colab?
steps.answer: `_sh(cmd)` is only defined and never called in this cell, and `"google.colab" in sys.modules` evaluates to `False` outside Colab.

steps.description: Line 11 checks `"google.colab" in sys.modules` and prints `In Colab: False`.
